topic: Compare with other or similar cities
situation (example wording): "compared to similar cities", "versus peer cities", "to other cities", "against 3 agencies of similar size", "other cities of a similar size".
what the app does today: Peer wording kept the decline (P187, D16) that asked for named agencies, or answered the place alone.
proposed behavior: The app asks "Which cities should it be compared with? For example, cities of similar size, or named cities." with one button, "Name the cities". It never picks a peer group itself and never answers the place alone. A place that has to be told apart (Richmond, Baltimore) is asked first; each of its buttons keeps the peer wording so the cities are still asked afterwards. "Other large cities" or "other major cities" is a different ask and is not changed.
exact default or choices offered: Question: "Which cities should it be compared with? For example, cities of similar size, or named cities." Button: "Name the cities".
why: Jeff 2026-11-24 (coordinator card, Q1 yes, Q2 no). Supersedes the peer part of P187 and D16.
test cases: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts: P305 block (six peer questions, Richmond first, three untouched comparisons).
